notes: Governing document: the USC Faculty Handbook 2017 (promulgated July 27, 2017), in force on the reference date 2018-03-13. Chapter 9 (Academic and Family Life Balance) sets paid parental leave, relief, part-time and probationary-period provisions; Chapter 3-E sets medical, statutory, personal and part-time leaves. The Employee Gateway 'New baby or adoption' page (Feb 2018 copy) is an HR summary that supplies the pregnancy-disability and PFL details; the Faculty Portal page is a summary pointing to the Handbook. The Chapter 10 pages carry a 2015 footer (phased retirement; not used).

Calendar: semesters ('fall and spring semesters', Handbook 3-E(2)); academic-year service Aug 16 - May 15 (3-B(5)); no term length stated, so calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order.

Member's path (U8): the Basic disability plan at 70% is coded; the Supplemental Plan (100% for one week per year of service up to 10 weeks, then 80%, 'if already enrolled') is an employee election, in duration_variants. The Gateway line 'Faculty - 100% for 10 weeks if approved by Provost' is read as the 9-G(2) paid-parental-leave supplement (c1).

Birth parent chain: pregnancy disability leave (PDL, up to 4 months) with FMLA 12 and the 10-week paid parental leave starting together (PPL tops disability pay to full pay; disability benefit 70% from week 2 for 9 weeks), the PPL inside the semester without classroom teaching (c2 contains c1) -> CFRA 12 weeks after PDL, with PFL 6 weeks concurrent with CFRA. The discretionary medical leave (c8) runs with PDL; the discretionary 9-B(2) unpaid leave runs with FMLA.

Non-birth parent chain: 10-week paid parental leave (primary caregiver only) with FMLA 12 and CFRA 12 concurrent from the start (CFRA linked concurrent_with FMLA for the non-birth role only), PFL 6 concurrent with CFRA; the semester without classroom teaching contains the PPL.

Not components: sabbatical leave (requires a research or study programme; not usable for a birth); jury duty and military leave; 4-E Special Leave of Absence on proof of severe incapacity and 3-I(2)(d) unpaid placement for absence over two weeks (placements by the Provost, not parental provisions); 4-D(1.5)(a) emergency clock stop declared by the Provost for university-wide disruptions; 9-E (expectations of productivity not raised after leave or exclusion: a protection of standards, no time or pay); department practice of supplementing PFL with sick or vacation hours (staff-oriented, 'Not all departments offer this option'); the FCML statement that FCML runs concurrently with paid disability leave 'up to a total leave not to exceed 12 weeks' (read as concurrency, not a combined cap).

No leave_limits recorded: 3-E(1) 'Most types of leave are granted for one semester, or one year as a maximum' and the one-year return rule are general statements, not a stated cap on combined leave for one event.

Documents cited but not saved: University sick leave policy (policy.usc.edu); staff Pregnancy-Related Medical Leave policy and the 'University policy' on pregnancy-disability leave followed by baby-bonding (Handbook 3-E(3)(c)); Faculty Paid Parental Leave Request and Faculty Family Leave Request Form; Disability section of the USC Benefits site and Employee Leave Disability Checklist; military leave and jury duty policies; Benefits policies defining Registered Domestic Partner; Request for Leave form; school-specific guidelines.
